text_blocks.snippet: In New York City, sex offender treatment programs are comprehensive and focus on reducing the risk of re-offending through various therapeutic approaches. These programs are typically offered by the Department of Corrections and Community Supervision, as well as by private providers. Treatment involves individual and group therapy, cognitive behavioral therapy, and relapse prevention strategies.
